verdict.rationale: Feitian ships management tools (iePassManager for Android, SK Manager) that handle FIDO PIN and 'credential related operations', which implies users can view and remove stored credentials. Biometric data is matched on-device and never leaves the key, which limits what is retained in the first place. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of deleting individual resident credentials or enrolled fingerprints, a full device reset/wipe procedure, any stated retention policy, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
